mapper.select:
select distinct stl.ACCT_NO as code,/**账号**/ stl.ACCT_NAME as shortName/**户名**/
,stl.SEQ_NO as seqNo
from STL_CAPACCT_INFO stl inner join BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO bok on stl.ACCT_NO = bok.ACCT_NO where 1=1
and ( UPPER(stl.ACCT_NO) LIKE concat(concat('%',UPPER(#{account})),'%') OR UPPER(stl.ACCT_NAME) LIKE concat(concat('%',UPPER(#{account})),'%') )

select stl.ACCT_NO acctNo,/**账号**/ stl.ACCT_NAME acctName,/**账户名**/ bok.ACCT_TYPE acctTypeCode,/**账户类型Code**/ bok.ACCT_TYPE acctType,/**账户类型**/ int.BASIS basis, /**计息基础**/
(case when int.INT_TYPE ='01'
then to_char(int.RATE*100,'FM999,999,999,999,999,999,990.0000') else int.BENCHMARK_ID end) as yield, int.INT_TYPE calcType,/**利率类型**/ to_char(int.EFF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')as effDate ,/**生效日**/ info.CASH_ID as cashId ,/**现金流代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId,/**账套代码**/ bok.CCY as ccy /**币种**/
,stl.SEQ_NO as seqNo
from STL_CAPACCT_INFO stl left join BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO bok on stl.ACCT_NO =bok.ACCT_NO inner join fin_cash_info info on stl.ACCT_NO=info.FINPROD_ID inner join
FIN_RATE_INFO int on info.CASH_ID = int.CASH_ID
where 1=1 and bok.ACCT_TYPE is not null
and int.INT_TYPE in
#{item}
and stl.ACCT_NO in
#{item}
AND bok.ACCT_TYPE in
#{item}
